name: NBER Summer Institute 2027: macroeconomics, monetary and forecasting workshops
conf_dates_note: Summer Institute runs in July; macro workshops (Monetary Economics, Impulse and Propagation Mechanisms, International Finance & Macroeconomics, Forecasting & Empirical Methods, EF&G, etc.) mostly in the first two weeks
expected_note: Submissions go through the general NBER Summer Institute call (usually posted around February); check which macro workshops accept open submissions. Estimated from the general SI 2026 deadline (26 Mar 2026, as recorded for other SI workshops in this database).
